summary: Inspected both new/changed files in the AleoVM circuits library. Both are authored ACL2 formal verification files containing definitions (defun/define), theorem statements (defruled/defrule/defruledl), and proof scripts with explicit hints. digits.lisp provides lemmas about bit-list to integer conversions (little/big-endian, two's complement) with linear arithmetic bounds. signed-small-abs-wrapped.lisp defines an R1CS gadget for wrapped absolute value and proves its soundness. Neither file is a build artifact, certification wrapper, or profiling sidecar — they are substantive formal mathematics in the main source tree.
